title: Mrs. Ilana Alouf: "Parashat Vayigash"

chapters.title: Introduction to Parashat Vayigash and Gisha
chapters.about: Introduction to the parasha and the concept of gisha as an approach to life

chapters.title: Yehuda's Corrective Behavior
chapters.about: Yehuda taking responsibility for Binyamin and rising from past mistakes

chapters.title: Yehuda Approaches Yosef
chapters.about: Yehuda's respectful yet firm leadership approach facing the ruler of Egypt

chapters.title: The Brothers' Blindness
chapters.about: Why the brothers assumed Yosef was dead and failed to recognize him

chapters.title: Leadership and the Path of Mashiach
chapters.about: The convergence of leadership lineages from Rachel and Leah

chapters.title: Yosef Witnesses Teshuvah
chapters.about: Yosef observing the complete teshuvah of Yehuda regarding Binyamin

summary: Mrs. Alouf goes through Parashat Vayigash, focusing on the powerful meeting between Yehuda and Yosef in Egypt and the psychological and historical significance of their interaction. She discusses Yehuda's transformation into a leader who takes full responsibility, the brothers' process of teshuvah, and how Yosef ultimately reveals his identity to them. The class also explores the themes of free choice versus God's plan and the foundations of Mashiach ben Yosef and Mashiach ben David.
questions: How does Yehuda approach Yosef when pleading for Binyamin?
Why didn't the brothers recognize Yosef in Egypt?
What role does teshuvah play in the interaction between Yosef and his brothers?
How do free choice and God's plan work together in the story of Yosef being sold?
What do Mashiach ben Yosef and Mashiach ben David represent in this parasha?
